title: CompleteConfig
description: Top-level configuration for utoopack.json This represents the JSON config file structure, aligned with pack-core's `Config` struct.

externals.description: External dependencies for client and Node-target builds, and the fallback for server builds

nodePolyfill.description: Enable Node.js polyfills for browser builds

turbopackMemoryEviction.description: Turbopack memory eviction mode for the persistent cache

oneOf.description: Glob pattern for content type matching

SchemaConfigConditionItem.description: Configuration condition item — supports compound conditions (all/any/not) and base conditions with path, content, query, and contentType matchers.

SchemaCopyItem.description: Copy item configuration Can be either a string (source path) or an object with from and optional to

anyOf.description: String variant: source path (destination will be same as source)
Object variant: source path and optional destination path

to.description: Destination path to copy to (optional, defaults to same as from)

SchemaCrossOriginLoadingMode.description: Cross-origin loading mode for dynamic chunks.

requestCost.description: Estimated cost of an additional request, in bytes

weightDistribution.description: Weight distribution used by the graph CSS chunking algorithm

localIdentName.description: CSS Modules local class name pattern

browserToTerminal.description: Forward browser console output to the development terminal

dynamicHmrChunkLists.description: Register HMR chunk lists as dynamic chunks are loaded

sourcemap.description: Enable source maps in Emotion transform

html.description: HTML generation configuration for this entry

import.description: Import path for the entry point

script.description: Script URL for script type externals

anyOf.description: Subpath external configuration (for complex path handling)

target.description: Target replacement pattern (supports $empty and template strings)

filename.description: Output filename for the generated HTML

template.description: Path to the HTML template file

inlineLimit.description: Inline limit for images in bytes

development.description: Whether to compile in development mode

jsx.description: Whether to preserve JSX in the MDX compiler output

anyOf.description: Simple boolean to enable/disable the Rust MDX transform

preventFullImport.description: Prevent full import of the package

SchemaModuleRuleItem.description: Item in a module rule array

compress.description: Whether to enable compression when minifying

concatenateModules.description: Whether to concatenate modules when possible to reduce the number of chunks. This can improve performance by reducing the number of requests and improving caching.

extractComments.description: Whether to extract legal comments to [file].LICENSE.txt when minifying library output

inferModuleSideEffects.description: Whether to infer side-effect-free modules from source code when package metadata does not declare side effects. Defaults to true.

nestedAsyncChunking.description: Whether to enable nested async chunking

removeUnusedExports.description: Whether to remove unused exports. Defaults to false in development, true in production.

removeUnusedImports.description: Whether to remove unused imports. Defaults to false in development, true in production.

wasmAsAsset.description: Whether to bundle WASM as asset. Defaults to false. When false, WASM files will be output as static assets.

assetModuleFilename.description: Filename pattern for asset modules (images, fonts, etc.)

chunkFilename.description: Filename pattern for JS chunk files

chunkLoadingGlobal.description: The global variable name used by the runtime for loading chunks. Default: 'TURBOPACK'

clean.description: Whether to clean output directory before build

crossOriginLoading.description: Controls crossorigin for dynamically loaded chunks. Supports false, 'anonymous', or 'use-credentials'.

cssChunkFilename.description: Filename pattern for CSS chunk files

cssFilename.description: Filename pattern for main CSS files

entryRootExport.description: Expose entry module exports to global scope with the specified name. When set, all named exports from the entry module will be available on window/globalThis under the specified name. If set to empty string, will use package.json name. Default: None (no exposure)

filename.description: Filename pattern for main JS files

publicPath.description: URL prefix prepended to all chunk and asset URLs. Use 'runtime' for globalThis.publicPath or 'auto' for current-script inference.

SchemaProviderConfigValue.description: Provider configuration value. Can be a simple module name string or a [module, export] tuple.

runtime.description: JSX runtime to use (automatic or classic)

renameAs.description: Rename the module as another extension

entry.description: Entry point for the server runtime (e.g. "src/server.ts")

externals.description: Server-specific externals. Replaces top-level externals for server entries and Server Functions when provided

resolve.description: Server-only resolution options. Alias entries override matching resolve.alias entries; extensions replace resolve.extensions when provided

clientProxy.description: Module that exports createServerReference(actionId, name) for client proxy

serverRegister.description: Module that exports registerServerReference(action, actionId, name) for the server bundle

emotion.description: Enable @emotion/react transform support with boolean or options

postcss.description: Inline PostCSS configuration appended after a discovered config file

SchemaTurbopackModuleType.description:
Module type for a module rule (`type` / `moduleType` field).

Values must match pack-core / Turbopack's `ConfiguredModuleType::parse()`.
